scripts.build: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('.next',{recursive:true,force:true}); const nextBin=require.resolve('next/dist/bin/next'); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[nextBin,'build'],{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,NODE_ENV:'production'}}); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
